think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s data type and allowed values from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether it is a numeric knob with a natural ordering. 3) If numeric, look for sentinel/special numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable/auto) rather than just scaling behavior. 4) If the knob is not numeric (e.g., boolean/enum), it does not fit the ‘special numerical knob’ definition here; classify as not a special knob under this criterion.
